title: Kodak invented the digital camera, then went bankrupt
caption:
In 1975, a Kodak engineer named Steve Sasson built the first digital camera.
Kodak made most of its money selling film. Digital threatened all of it.
So it moved slowly. Rivals didn't.
In 2012, Kodak filed for bankruptcy.
comment: Can you name a company making the same mistake today? 👇
sources: Steve Sasson / Kodak digital camera history (Kodak, IEEE)
